name: trtmc-agent-skills
description: Repo-local Codex skills for TensorRT-Model-Connect developer workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Repo skills for Git and GitHub workflows
interface.longDescription: Installs TensorRT-Model-Connect Codex skills for commit messages, GitHub issues, pull requests, and PR readiness.
defaultPrompt: Use $write-git-messages to draft a PR message from my diff.
Use $submit-github-pr to push this branch and open a PR.
Use $submit-github-bug-issue to file a reproducible bug report.
Use $pr-babysitter to drive an existing PR to ready to merge.
